## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior or documentation improvement.

## Evidence

For factual changes, link the Antfly source revision and implementation paths.
For runtime claims, record the tested Antfly and harness versions.

## Validation

- [ ] Reference checks (include whether an OpenAPI contract was supplied)
- [ ] Library validation
- [ ] Credential scan
- [ ] Shell syntax checks, if scripts changed

Describe any live verification, or explain why it is not applicable. Note any
remaining limitations.
